findings.text: Acceptance 1 requires a cold reader of either contract to classify the mixed list correctly, but the second adversary trial still assigns item 3 to the reviewer and scores 7/8. This leaves an executable probe-artifact normalization defect with both roles able to reject ownership.
findings.fix: Clarify the adversary positioning paragraph so executable defects in probe recording or artifact normalization belong to the adversary, then rerun the same cold-read classification until both isolated contracts produce the expected 8/8 split.

findings.text: This unrelated open intent is committed in the reviewed delta and would ship with a branch whose stated change is reviewer/adversary positioning. That makes the branch deliver more than its confirmed intent and obscures the PR's actual scope.
findings.fix: Move commit aa4847ab and this intent onto its own branch, leaving this branch's delta limited to the confirmed positioning change and its evidence.

findings.text: The positioning paragraph omits the intent's promised statement that the reviewer's output is a claim confirmed through the fix round. Later sections describe fix rounds, so this does not presently direct execution incorrectly, but the delivered paragraph does not fully match Proposed outcome 2.
findings.fix: Add a concise clause stating that the reviewer's claim is confirmed in the fix round while keeping the paragraph within 80 words.

findings.text: The report says no existing change records were written, but this delta adds the unrelated open intent at docs/loom/intent/2026-09-04-prefer-harness-native-file-tools.md.
findings.fix: After removing the unrelated intent from this branch, retain the statement; otherwise revise it to disclose the additional committed intent.

findings.text: Plan W1-01 and intent Proposed outcome 2 require the reviewer positioning paragraph to state that its output is a claim the fix round confirms. The shipped paragraph drops the clause entirely (79/80 words, one word of headroom); blind-run-report.md names the drop as a fact but no decision point resolved it and the artifact carries no annotation.
findings.fix: Compress an existing clause to make room for a clause equivalent to 'your finding is a claim the fix round confirms', or get the cut confirmed at a decision point and record it in the intent/plan.

findings.text: Cold-read evidence from this round (evidence/coldread-reviewer.txt:21, evidence/coldread-adversary.txt:19, both TRIAL 2, i.e. after the fix round) shows the finding class 'the same artifact recorded under two spellings/paths counted twice' is claimed by neither role: the reviewer-only reader assigns it to the adversary and the adversary-only reader assigns it to the reviewer. The fix round's added boundary language did not close it.
findings.fix: Add one disambiguating clause claiming probe-bookkeeping questions (how one probe's own artifact path is spelled or counted) for the adversary, leaving cross-document count reconciliation to the reviewer.

Did not re-run the cold-read trials in evidence/coldread-*.txt; read as evidence only.
